paragraphs: Deledao sells web filtering to K-12 schools, built on patented technology the company says analyzes each webpage as a human would. The product line later grew to cover student safety and classroom management.

The filter blurs, mutes, and screens inappropriate images and video frame by frame. It detects gaming behavior from keyboard and mouse activity without logging keystrokes. Proxy sites students use to bypass filtering are caught automatically. Teachers get visibility into student tabs or screens. Websites can be allowed or blocked by group or by individual student. The wellness product looks for cyberbullying, self-harm, and toxic language across platforms. High-risk alerts receive human review and escalation to the district.

The company names Shuang Ji as its chief executive. Its first product, a web filter using real-time AI, launched in 2019. It says it now supports schools in the United States, Canada, Europe, New Zealand, and Australia. Case studies on the site describe schools adopting the filter for CIPA compliance and student safety.
